_label: TEST-ONLY THRESHOLD CONFIGURATION — NOT PRODUCTION POLICY
_source_of_truth: docs/llm_scope_and_constraints.md (TASK-24) §5 defines these parameters and deliberately leaves their values unset. Final values remain pending TASK-18 and TASK-23. Nothing in this file constitutes a calibration decision.
_purpose: Prompt V2 cannot be executed without concrete numbers. These values are IDENTICAL to prompts/v1/test_thresholds.json by design: holding thresholds fixed is what makes the V1-vs-V2 comparison attributable to the prompt rather than to a threshold change. They carry no empirical justification and must not be cited as recommended values.
_replace_when: TASK-18 selects the production damage model and TASK-23 measures matching accuracy. Replace the values below; the prompt and runner read them from here and need no edits.
_comparability: Do not change these values without also re-running V1. Any change invalidates the stored V1-vs-V2 comparison in prompts/v2/README.md.
